mintAuthority.summary: USDon has three issuer-native issuance surfaces. Ethereum and BNB Chain use separate upgradeable AccessControlEnumerable proxies with chain-local GMTokenManager and Safe MINTER_ROLE holders plus 2-hour Timelock-controlled admin/upgrade paths; Solana uses an Ondo Global Markets program with a Token-2022 mint-authority PDA, role-gated mint_usdon, pause/config authorities, and a separately governed BPF upgrade authority. These native controls are reviewed per deployment and are not bridge controls.

controls.label: Ondo Global Markets Solana USDon mint authority PDA
controls.capDescription: The Solana mint_usdon instruction enforces a fixed 10,000,000-token-per-call maximum, but repeated role-authorized calls have no whole-supply cap in the reviewed program source.
bypassSurfaces: Token-2022 pausable/config, metadata, scaled-UI, confidential-transfer, and transfer-hook authorities all point to the mint authority PDA
MinterRoleUSDon/AdminRoleUSDon role accounts and GuardianUSDon governance

Ondo's verified program source requires MinterRoleUSDon or AdminRoleUSDon for mint_usdon, caps each call at MAX_MINT_AMOUNT = 10,000,000 tokens, and makes USDon role grant/revoke GuardianUSDon-gated; the generic grant_role path is upgrade-authority-gated.

controls.label: Ondo Global Markets Solana BPF upgrade authority
bypassSurfaces: Can replace Ondo Global Markets program logic and alter role, mint, pause, or configuration checks
controls.evidence: At Solana context slot 439720621, the Ondo Global Markets program XzTT4XB8m7sLD2xi6snefSasaswsKCxx5Tifjondogm resolved to ProgramData F4F1ZdqwmT4KfCfCnXrqLp9R6Liq4vEqJcs64xVKTKeU, whose upgrade_authority_address was 9ECeczLtFZDYE3NX6G7uNw5BUGjoJAu1kFyEihA5hMaM. The authority account was a non-executable System-owned account. Verified source constrains generic grant_role and revoke_role to the current BPF upgrade authority, so this authority can replace program logic and establish or revoke role accounts.

review.evidence: USDon has three independently reviewed native issuance surfaces, not one global mint control and not a bridge-only mint path. Ethereum block 25295047 recorded GMTokenManager 0x2c158bc456e027b2affccadf1bdbd9f5fc4c5c8c, a 3-of-6 Safe 0x7607c08928bdbab77f88872b49667dcb877524db, and TimelockController 0x3715b2154d2ff4c5b027c7a1f734b53f27bc34f1 controlling MINTER_ROLE, DEFAULT_ADMIN, and the ProxyAdmin upgrade path with a 7200-second delay. At BNB block 116343980, the separate USDon proxy implementation was 0x7655539c985743c3d29aff4c8ae2730f9360f7a6, ProxyAdmin 0x005793c2c4c966a0d261d60ffcba4269fa72bdc2 was owned by TimelockController 0x8860bbfc7a83e4788a981f4e9f30878331413b26, MINTER_ROLE holders were GMTokenManager 0x91f8aff3738825e8eb16fc6f6b1a7a4647bdb299 and Safe 0x4d25d4790b4ec8b40605da55509479047a3d4728, and the BNB Safe was 3-of-6 with no modules or guard. At Solana slots 439720646/439720621, Token-2022 USDon supply was nonzero with mint authority 9foMHsSDq7nMg4WPusSz9eY7tyxyukqborA8GyU5cUxD, freeze authority 51QVCuHfL1FeNjd8BDeffCKhCcAYoULnVB3yjNhShiuK, paused=false, and the Ondo program upgrade authority was 9ECeczLtFZDYE3NX6G7uNw5BUGjoJAu1kFyEihA5hMaM. Ondo's source requires USDon mint roles and caps each admin mint call at 10,000,000 tokens, while role grants are GuardianUSDon- or upgrade-authority-governed. Regulation S restricts U.S.-person minting; no permissionless mint path is evidenced. USDon is issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-16: direct minters have no firm whole-supply economic cap, and the owner/admin escape paths remain outside any user collateral gate. Wave 2 external research reviewed 2026-08-15: Ondo documents daily collateral reports reviewed by Ankura, monthly reconciliation, and annual audits; recurring dated Ankura reports enumerate USDon outstanding across Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Solana within total platform liabilities and reconcile those liabilities to reviewed brokerage assets.
